issue.title: GitHub-hosted WFM browser-proof runner below current Chrome security floor

wfm_evaluation.customer_impact: No customer production runtime exposure identified. The risk is confined to the GitHub-hosted authenticated staging browser-proof job, which would otherwise expose a scoped demo credential to an outdated browser process.
wfm_evaluation.exploitability: Requires malicious or compromised browser content capable of reaching one of the affected Chrome code paths. The WFM proof origin is controlled, but compromise of that origin or a browser-reachable dependency would make an outdated privileged CI browser an avoidable attack surface.

containment.action: Fail closed before WFM_DEMO_PASSWORD is injected into the browser step when Google Chrome is below 153.0.8010.47.
containment.observed_result: The security-floor assertion rejected Chrome 152.0.7977.82 and the authenticated browser journey was skipped.

regression_test.method: Parse google-chrome --version on every protected browser-proof run and compare each numeric component with 153.0.8010.47 before the secret-bearing step.
regression_test.expected_safe_result: Browser proof proceeds only when Chrome is at or above the current fixed security floor; otherwise it terminates before secret injection.

remediation.current: Keep authenticated browser proof blocked on stale GitHub-hosted runner images.
remediation.next: Re-run the same gate when the hosted ubuntu-24.04 image carries a patched Chrome stable build, or adopt a separately integrity-verified patched browser artifact before re-enabling the secret-bearing browser step.
do_not: switch to Playwright 1.63.0 bundled Chromium 153.0.8010.12 as a workaround because it is below the 153.0.8010.47 Chrome security floor
